name: HadCRUT5 Global Surface Temperature Anomaly Dataset
description: HadCRUT5 is the fifth generation gridded dataset of global historical surface temperature anomalies jointly produced by the UK Met Office Hadley Centre and the Climatic Research Unit (CRU) at the University of East Anglia. Spanning 1850 to the present at monthly 5°x5° resolution, HadCRUT5 combines land surface air temperatures from CRUTEM5 with sea surface temperature measurements from HadSST4. HadCRUT5 provides two versions: a non-infilled version and an infilled version produced using statistical Gaussian process regression to achieve global spatial coverage, supported by a 200-member ensemble that quantifies observational and sampling uncertainties.
